Samir —

Thanks for the sync earlier. As discussed, we want to capture the mutual action plan (MAP) items that will let HelixCare finish the evaluation and select a hosting mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and production region. I attached a starter MAP with milestones — please review and confirm the items below so we can lock timelines into the purchase order.

Key asks from HelixCare for closing:
- Confirm desired deployment mode for Prod and PoC (Hosted preferred, Dedicated for isolated throughput, Private if on-prem/regulatory).
- Confirm primary region (us-east-1 or us-west-2) and any EU node requirement for PHI scope.
- Security/compliance docs requested: SOC 2 evidence, data retention policy, audit log sample (we can provide redact-friendly artifacts).
- Performance gates for the PoC: 200 QPS sustained with p95 latency < 300ms (documented in MAP).

Deliverables we will provide:
- MAP PDF (attached) with sprint-level milestones
- Deployment options spreadsheet (attached) comparing cost/latency tradeoffs
- A one-day on-site (or virtual) performance runbook for the PoC

Timeline proposal (tentative):
- 10/22: HelixCare confirms hosting mode + region
- 10/26: Redwood delivers test env + security artifacts
- 11/02 - 11/06: PoC performance window
- 11/10: Decision close & term sheet submitted

Please reply with confirmations or if you want us to sketch a dedicated-only path (we can attach throughput profiles).

Best,
Laura Bennett

Thanks for the clear plan and attachments. Quick answers and a couple of follow-ups from our side:

1) Hosting mode: For the PoC we are comfortable starting on Hosted to move quickly. For production, we need a firm recommendation: our ops team prefers Dedicated for predictable throughput, but our security team is asking whether Private (VPC/on-prem) is required for PHI — do you have a checklist of the controls that would only be satisfied by Private?

2) Region: Primary preference is us-east-1, but we need confirmation on data residency for PHI before finalizing.

3) Procurement: our procurement lead wants the expected monthly run-rate for both Hosted and Dedicated at the target QPS so we can budget. Can your team provide an estimated cost delta?

4) Security artifacts: send SOC 2 + example audit logs. Also, will Redwood sign a standard BAA if needed?

If we can get those answers by EOD 10/22 we should be able to meet your timeline.

—Samir

Samir —

Thanks for the quick reply. I pulled together a concise comparison and answers to your questions — summarized below. I'll attach the workbook with the cost scenarios used for the estimates.

Short answers:
- Private (on-prem) is typically required only when your legal / compliance team mandates full infrastructure control and no cross-tenant control plane connectivity. If the requirement is strictly PHI handling with standard safeguards (encryption at rest/in transit, customer-managed keys, audit logs), Dedicated in a VPC + KMS typically satisfies it.
- Redwood can sign a BAA; we'll route through legal.
- Region: us-east-1 meets residency; we can deploy a regional-only flow to ensure logs and tokenization remain in-region.

Cost & latency delta (very high level):
- Hosted: fastest to start; lower up-front, higher per-token running cost at sustained high QPS due to multi-tenant pricing. Estimated monthly run-rate at 200 QPS (mixed prompt/stream) = ~$45k–$60k depending on caching and batching.
- Dedicated: higher committed cost (reserved GPUs) but unit cost drops ~30–45% once commitment is sized for sustained 200 QPS. Estimated monthly run-rate = ~$30k–$40k (after reserved discount).
- Private (on-prem): large infra capex/OPEX; single-tenant control but highest initial integration effort.

Security artifacts we can provide by 10/22: SOC 2 Type II summary, sample audit log extract (redacted), and our data retention & deletion policy. I attached the deployment-options workbook we used.

Next steps I propose:
- 10/22 EOD: HelixCare confirms PoC uses Hosted (ok) and Prod preference (Dedicated vs Private).
- 10/23: Redwood provides a committed cost estimate for Dedicated with a 12-month and 36-month amortized view.
- 10/26: Test env + security artifacts delivered.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min ops deep-dive on 10/22 afternoon to walk the dedicated sizing assumptions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference
